items.body: A delivery proposal stays pending if its attempt retries before Describe observes Started. Reproduced against the committed WASM: propose `Worker::Poll(1)`, Answer `RetryThenComplete`, then Judge Scheduled/attempt 2. Judge explains the retry but returns `continue_polling=true`; subsequent Propose refuses STATE. Even observing Started/attempt 2 keeps Poll(1) pending. Since attempts cannot return to 1, the proposal cannot finish until terminal closure, blocking further proposals and potentially causing a read timeout after delivery already succeeded.
items.suggestion: Complete Poll when the validated prospective state has advanced beyond its target attempt, as well as when Started is observed for that attempt. Add a regression covering retry between callback delivery and the first Describe read.
items.title: A delivery proposal stays pending if its attempt retries before Describe observes Started

items.body: The correlation fallback accepts Describe evidence for a pending Cancel. Reproduced against the committed wasm: Answer `Complete` → Propose `Client::Cancel` → Judge Describe `Completed`. Judge explains `Worker::RespondCompleted`, clears the cancellation proposal, and permits another Propose despite never receiving the cancellation result. Matching the activity identity does not establish that this observation explains the pending cancellation.
items.suggestion: Restrict Describe correlation to `ObserveActivity` proposals. Require the matching Cancel invocation’s result before clearing a cancellation proposal, and add a crossed-method negative control.
items.title: The correlation fallback accepts Describe evidence for a pending Cancel
